up: List all approved drugs (with max_phase = 4 in molecule_dictionary) that have an agonist mechanism of action recorded in the drug_mechanism table (action_type = 'AGONIST'). For each such drug, show the drug name (pref_name), the drug's ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the target name (target_dictionary.pref_name), the target's ChEMBL ID (target_dictionary.chembl_id), the target organism (target_dictionary.organism), and the canonical SMILES of the drug (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Use the following join relationships: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_mechanism.molregno, drug_mechanism.tid = target_dictionary.tid, and molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Return one row per drug–target pair. Do not apply any limit on the number of rows returned.
sql:
SELECT
  md.pref_name AS drug_name,
  md.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase = 4
  AND dm.action_type = 'AGONIST';
